queries.name: GetReferenceById
queries.output: current reference projection plus revision/lifecycle; Customer Organization includes current active Customer Account Code claim summary and history count; Contact includes current affiliation plus active-channel count/first bounded page only; Dispatch Location includes current_address projection source
rules: historical lookup may return archived records
no query mutates or materializes defaults
large channel/history collections use dedicated paginated subqueries rather than unbounded inline expansion
Dispatch site-derived address is obtained through SiteDispatchAddressProvider rather than copied from LLD-08 tables

queries.name: ListActiveReferences
queries.pagination: deterministic keyset cursor over normalized display sort key then immutable ID; caller limit is clamped to bounds.json page policy, never OFFSET-scanned for ordinary navigation
rules: archived excluded
exact total is optional and computed only when the governed UI/export explicitly asks for it
set-based projection avoids N+1 per-row affiliation/channel/Site queries
Dispatch Location remains customer-neutral; optional Site/customer context is presentation metadata only

queries.name: MatchCustomerOrganization
input: optional raw Customer Organization label; at least one governed key required
rules: Customer Account Code is preferred stable external evidence
multiple reviewed account-code claimants return AMBIGUOUS
display name alone never authorizes identity mutation
account-code/name conflict returns AMBIGUOUS review state
candidate_count reflects the complete union while candidate_ids are bounded/paginated
matcher never assigns/reassigns the code

queries.name: PreviewCustomerAccountCodeConflict
rules: read-only
hash binds the complete claimant set even when display items paginate
preview is advisory and mutating command recomputes snapshot under its UnitOfWork
review_context_id from an import/proposal may be carried separately but never substitutes for the snapshot hash

queries.name: GetCustomerAccountCodeHistory
queries.rule: superseded claims remain historical evidence and never become current matching authority

queries.name: GetContactChannels
rules: ordinary recipient selection requests active channels only
historical/admin view may request archived channels
no unbounded Contact detail collection

queries.name: ValidateContactChannelForUse
rules: pure query/prerequisite validation
AUTO_SELECT never guesses between multiple usable channels unless the consuming workflow has a separately accepted deterministic selection rule
no DNS/network/email-service access

queries.name: MatchContact
rules: only active Contact/channel/current-affiliation rows participate
email equality outside the requested scope is not a candidate collision for that scope
candidate_count reflects complete union and candidate IDs are returned in stable immutable-ID order with pagination
ambiguous result remains ambiguous regardless of visible page

queries.name: GetContactAffiliationHistory
queries.rule: history is read from preserved relationship rows; current Customer labels do not rewrite historical operational snapshots owned by other domains

queries.name: PreviewReferenceArchive
queries.rule: would_be_eligible derives from exact blocker count over every registered validator, never from the visible page; preview is advisory and ArchiveReference reruns bounded guards inside its authoritative UnitOfWork

queries.name: GetSetting
rules: unknown key rejected
absent row returns code-defined default without insertion
secret-classified definitions are not exposed through ordinary setting storage

queries.name: ListSettingsForOwner
queries.output: registered definitions joined to optional persisted values
rules: registry order is deterministic
registry is code-bounded rather than operational-data-sized
missing rows remain source DEFAULT
query has zero persistence side effects

performance_rules: ordinary collection queries use keyset cursors over supporting indexes
exact COUNT is not performed on every list by default; it is requested only where the UI/workflow needs it
query implementations use bounded joins/subqueries and must not issue one SQL query per returned row
all route-supplied type/sort identifiers resolve through closed enums and never become raw SQL fragments
